_enabled_note: Master switch. Stays false until API keys + platform accounts are live. Nothing in the beat runs while this is false.

gemini._model_note: Nano Banana. Swap to 'gemini-3-pro-image-preview' for Nano Banana Pro.
gemini._quota_note: Google AI Pro covers the Gemini app/AI Studio UI, not API quota. On sustained 429 the beat parks remaining briefs instead of burning retries.

vectorizer._note: filter_speckle 8 + color_precision 6 keeps flat commercial art clean without shredding gradients. Tune here, never in code.
vectorizer._mode_note: polygon, not spline: we flatten curves to polylines during simplification anyway, and polygon traces start ~35% smaller (measured 104KB vs 537KB on the same source). Set spline + cleaner.simplify_mode=preserve_curves if a niche needs smooth organic curves.

cleaner._epsilon_note: Douglas-Peucker tolerance in viewBox units (1024 canvas), so 2.0 is a ~2px deviation. Measured on a photographic worst case: eps 1.0=33%, 2.0=53%, 3.0=61% node reduction. Flat vector art reduces far more. The fidelity gate catches anything simplified past recognition.

gate._fidelity_note: Renders raw trace vs cleaned SVG via cairosvg and compares. Catches simplification that destroyed the artwork.
gate._anchor_note: ABSOLUTE anchor budget is the real gate — this is what platforms reject on. Node-reduction percentage is recorded for tuning but is deliberately NOT a pass condition: an asset that traced cleanly and needed no simplification must not be failed for having little to reduce.

tagger._note: Tagging defaults to openrouter/free so the whole Gemini quota can be spent on image generation.

distribution._enabled_note: Hard second gate. Even with master enabled, nothing leaves this machine until this is true.
distribution._order_note: Highest royalty first, so a backlog always drains toward the best payout.

budget._note: Gemini path records $0. The ceiling exists so a silent switch to a paid backend cannot run away with spend.

politeness._note: vtracer is CPU-heavy. Never contend with the video farm's ffmpeg/encode stages.
